articles.summary: Archer’s ‘No Roads’ flight tour will begin in Northern California with a series of city-to-city flights, coming on the heels of more than 70 test flights in August alone and Archer’s recent successful roundtrip flight from Salinas to Monterey. Archer is closely coordinating its ‘No Roads’ tour flights with the FAA. Locations are expected to include Monterey, Hollister, San Martin, San Jose, Oakland, San Francisco and around the Los Angeles area, as well as flights in Texas and Florida. Goal of the tour is to showcase the advantages electric air taxis will bring: low noise, zero operating emissions, and the ability to skip over traffic—featuring flights on routes that can take an hour or more by car, but just 10–20 minutes in the air. The tour is set to advance Archer’s operational readiness for its role as the Official Air Taxi Provider of the LA28 Games and as part of the White House’s eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP). articles.title: Archer Launches ‘No Roads’ Flight Tour As Part Of Its Participation In White House’s Air Taxi Pilot Program and Preparation for LA28 Games
